jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.  

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

As our Chief of Staff, you will act as a force multiplier for the leadership team, driving alignment, ensuring execution, and creating leverage across the business. This role is for someone who is hungry and has exceptionally high agency. You should thrive on ambiguity, take ownership, and know how to create value without waiting for direction. No task is too big or too small.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Partner with the CEO and leadership team to prioritize, execute, and track progress on the highest-impact strategic initiatives across the company

 - Streamline decision-making, manage leadership cadences, and ensure follow-through on commitments to create leverage for leadership

 - Work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Growth, and Customer Success to close gaps, accelerate progress, and unlock new opportunities

 - Build trust and alignment across teams to enable collaboration without relying on formal reporting lines

 - Step into ambiguous, high-priority efforts such as launching new processes, tackling operational bottlenecks, or testing new growth levers

 - Provide strategic input, surface insights, and help shape the future direction of Profound




WHO YOU ARE

 - Hungry and high-agency operator, ambitious, driven, and proactive, seeing gaps and filling them without waiting for permission

 - Experienced owner with a background as a product manager, founder, or early operator, owning outcomes end to end

 - Collaborative leader skilled at influencing and driving alignment across teams without formal authority

 - Strategic and tactical, equally comfortable thinking big picture and diving into execution details, with no task too big or too small

 - Resilient and resourceful, thriving in ambiguity, adapting quickly, and biasing toward action




LOCATION

This is an on-site role based in our Union Square, NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.

For this role, the expected base salary range is $150,000 to $200,000. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.



#LI-DNI

Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

As we scale rapidly, we are hiring a People Operations Manager to own people operations and the employee experience, from onboarding and manager enablement to performance conversations, benefits, and compliance.



This is a hands-on, builder role for someone who wants to be close to the business, help leaders and employees day to day, and build lightweight people processes that actually work at a fast-growing startup.



What you’ll do

 - Maintain Rippling as the source of truth for people data, ensuring accuracy across the employee lifecycle - from open requisitions and hire records to role changes, compensation updates, and offboarding

 - Own global employee onboarding end to end, including the bespoke needs of cross-functional partners across time zones, with a commitment to timeliness, data accuracy, and a great first experience

 - Respond to inquiries from employees and cross-functional partners: payroll, finance, legal, IT, and recruiting with accuracy, care, and a bias toward resolution

 - Partner across Operations, Finance, Legal, and external vendors to build an interconnected people operations system that scales with the company

 - Manage payroll, benefits administration, open enrollment, and compliance across our global employee base, leveraging Rippling to optimize and automate wherever possible

 - Support employment verifications, employment documentation, and immigration and compliance matters in partnership with legal

 - Continuously measure and improve the employee experience - tracking operational metrics and using them to identify gaps and drive iteration

 - Act as a thought leader in leveraging AI and automation to eliminate repetitive administrative work, raise accuracy, and deliver a best-in-class employee experience

 - Bring people operations work currently handled by external partners in-house, building lightweight, scalable processes that work for a fast-growing global team



Who you are

 - 5+ years in people operations or HR at a high-growth startup, with direct experience scaling through rapid headcount growth

 - Deep proficiency with Rippling - across HRIS, payroll, benefits, devices, and system access and comfort with advanced data analysis to surface operational insights

 - The ability to deconstruct people processes to their core components, identify root causes for gaps, and rebuild them with less overhead

 - Experience supporting a globally distributed workforce and navigating the compliance and operational complexity that comes with it

 - Fantastic communication and interpersonal skills. You can explain a benefits renewal or a payroll change to anyone and make it feel simple

 - A genuine passion for building systems that scale and employee moments that feel effortless, especially through AI-powered solutions

 - Unwavering attention to detail and a high bar for accuracy - you treat data integrity as a craft




LOCATION

This is an on-site role based in our NYC or SF office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.

For this role, the expected base salary range is $130,000 to $190,000. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. jobs.title: GTM Enablement Program Manager
jobs.description:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.  

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

As GTM Enablement Program Manager, you'll help to build and shape Profound’s most high-impact programs and initiatives across our GTM functions. Partnering with the GTM leaders and cross-functional teams, you'll own the construction, execution and iteration of the enablement programs end-to-end. You'll build systems and run them, which includes cross-functional program leadership, direct training and enablement of tenured reps, along with content and curriculum development for managers, reps, and new hires. You’ll work closely with these teams to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement in performance and effectiveness both during and beyond ramp. This role will function as an individual contributor alongside our Field Enablement team to execute and measure against performance indicators both at the individual and business level. You will have the creativity and space to design programs that leave a lasting impact across the business at large.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own enablement programs end to end, from scoping and needs analysis through build, rollout, measurement, and iteration.

 - Partner with GTM leaders across Sales, CS, Marketing, Product, and RevOps to turn business priorities into clear program goals, owners, and timelines.

 - Build and deliver content and curriculum for new hires, tenured reps, and managers, including outlines, decks, playbooks, and role plays.

 - Facilitate live trainings and workshops for audiences ranging from new hires to senior leaders.

 - Up-level front-line and second-line leaders as they build their teams, with a focus on coaching, inspection, and reinforcing new behaviors in the field.

 - Identify performance gaps during and beyond ramp, and design targeted programs to close them.

 - Define success metrics for every program and track them at both the rep and business level, reporting results to stakeholders.

 - Lead the implementation and adoption of enablement technology as we build out that arm of the function.

 - Work alongside the Field Enablement team to keep programs consistent, well documented, and easy to scale.


WHO YOU ARE

 - 9+ years of combined experience in client-facing roles and revenue enablement, including 4+ years in a direct client-facing role (Sales or Customer Success) and 5+ years on a Revenue Enablement Team.

 - You’ve built and run programs end to end in B2B SaaS and can point to measurable business results.

 - You influence senior stakeholders with professionalism and respect while holding your ground when priorities compete.

 - You are a strong facilitator and communicator, comfortable leading a room of new hires one day and a leadership team the next.

 - You have coached or enabled front-line managers and know how to turn manager behavior into rep behavior.

 - You have rolled out enablement tools and driven real adoption, not just implementation.

 - Meticulous in your ownership: your content, plans, and follow-through are accurate and on time.

 - A self-starter and team player with high energy who works well with autonomy and ambiguity.

 - Curious and experienced with AI; you work to implement and leverage it to change both the way we sell and the way we support our GTM teams.


LOCATION

This is an on-site role based in our NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.

For this role, the expected base salary range is $180,000 to $220,000. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks.
